children: shares climbed nearly 6% on Tuesday morning after the chipmaker lifted its fiscal 2028 revenue target and outlined longer-term growth plans at its investor day.

Marvell now expects fiscal 2028 revenue of about $20 billion, up from its previous $18 billion forecast and above the $18.2 billion analyst consensus compiled by LSEG. The updated outlook reflects demand for chips used in data-center infrastructure.

The company also set a fiscal 2031 revenue range of $70 billion to $90 billion, with the $80 billion midpoint above the $46.85 billion analyst estimate cited by Visible Alpha. Custom silicon is expected to remain an important growth driver as technology companies develop specialized processors for AI workloads.

The updated targets build on Marvell's recent momentum. Fiscal second-quarter 2027 revenue reached a record $2.739 billion, up 37% from a year earlier, while data-center revenue increased 46%. Marvell had also raised its fiscal 2027 and 2028 outlook in August as AI-related demand remained strong.

title: Marvell Stock Jumps on Massive $20 Billion Revenue Forecast
